mapper.sql: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password_hash, u.real_name, u.dept, u.role_id, u.email, u.skill_tags, u.weekly_capacity, u.status, u.last_login_at, u.created_at, u.updated_at, r.code AS role_code, r.name AS role_name, r.permissions AS role_permissions FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = u.role_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user (username, password_hash, real_name, dept, role_id, email, skill_tags, weekly_capacity) VALUES (#{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{realName}, #{dept}, #{roleId}, #{email}, #{skillTags,typeHandler=org.miniteam.pms.common.mybatis.JsonStringListTypeHandler}, #{weeklyCapacity})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}

where.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: WHERE u.status = 1 AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY u.id LIMIT #{limit}
